### Bowls of Divine Wrath
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/bowls-of-divine-wrath
Passage: Revelation 15:5-8
Points:
- The seven angels emerge from the heavenly sanctuary dressed like high priests, showing that their mission of judgment is holy.
- God's wrath is never a petty loss of temper, but the righteous reaction of infinite holiness against unatoned sin.
- The golden bowls link back to the incense bowls of the saints' prayers, showing that divine judgment answers Christian prayer.
- The overwhelming glory and power of God fill the temple with smoke, barring entry until the plagues are completed.
- The final consummation and new creation cannot take place until God's holy wrath against evil is fully carried out.
